name: Run Chart
description: Median run chart with four runs tests
whenToUse: Look at a series over time for non-random patterns — clustering, mixtures, trends, oscillation — before building control limits.
alphaHint: Threshold below which a test is flagged (default 0.05).
testDesc_clustering: Too few runs about the median — level shift or mixed population
testDesc_mixtures: Too many runs about the median — superimposed sources
testDesc_trends: Too few runs ↑/↓ — drift, wear, warm-up effect
testDesc_oscillation: Too many runs ↑/↓ — over-correction, systematic zigzag
